newsitem.title: USA: CME lumber rallies strongly on mill shutdown news.
newsitem.headline: CME lumber rallies strongly on mill shutdown news.

text.p: CME lumber futures rallied sharply in mid-morning trade, erasing early losses and moving higher, boosted by news of mill shutdowns, traders said.

Finlay Forest Industries Inc announced late Tuesday a two-week temporary market shutdown at each of its two sawmills located in Mackenzie, British Columbia and there was talk shutdowns at other companies' mills would follow.
At 1035 CDT July was up $3.20 at $357.90 per thousand board feet, well above its early low of $349.20.
Floor sources said the market fell early on continued weakness in the cash market but its ability to hold above Monday's low of $348.00 prompted technical support.
